name: whop-view
description: wv: a human view layer for the Whop CLI. Unofficial design prototype, not affiliated with Whop.
author: srikarsunchu

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && rm -rf dist/hints && cp -R src/hints dist/hints
scripts.demo: pnpm build && rm -rf demo/*.frames && for t in demo/*.tape; do case $t in *_common*) ;; *) vhs "$t";; esac; done && sh scripts/gif.sh
scripts.skill: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/skill.ts && mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && for s in whop-gtm whop-money whop-support; do rm -rf ~/.claude/skills/$s && cp -R skills/$s ~/.claude/skills/$s && echo installed ~/.claude/skills/$s; done
